user_reviews.Name: Todd Barnes
user_reviews.Description:
I have been a return customer for years.  But in September I purchased a new set of tires for my vehicle. At the start they didn't reset my tire sensors. I had to return. I told them to simply swap front passenger with driver rear and it was good. Drove for a month. Was never told they put two different size tires on my vehicle. Not only that, they put the two bigger tires on the of my vehicle. One was saved when they swapped the two tires. The one still on drivers front rubbed the strut bottom to the point of wearing a line in the tire.  I didn't find this out until I had front brakes replaced. I went back and that's when they told me of the two different sizes. The shop guy took the bad tire off the driver's front and put it on the passenger rear. Yeah, no offer of replacement due to their negligence. I had told them that I was hearing a rub from the back with the slightest road dip. So now with both bigger tires on the back I hear it more. Not to mention that when they told me of the two different size tires, the shop guy also told me my directional tires were put on in reverse! So now I have a vibration, a bad bearing, and rubbing in the back from bigger tires that should have been put on my car. The managers resolution is for me to purchase another set of tires! I simply want my vehicle corrected! Give me a new set of the correct tires since these are no good and too big due to their negligence. MAKE YOUR MISTAKE RIGHT​!!

Notice how they respond to positive reviews, but not to one's where they have created issues for a customer. Today is 3/31/2026, and i have yet to hear from anyone. Piss poor customer service! And no use in calling corporate because they don't return calls either. It's been months now. Rims and tires are sitting in my garage. New manager ain't no good either. Says call me, then you call and can't reach him. And leaving your name and number is useless!

user_reviews.Name: Music Lover
user_reviews.Description:
On my drive home this morning, I experienced a flat tire. After searching online for tire shops open on a Sunday, I began calling those closest to me. The first shop left me on hold for ten minutes, and the second routed me to a fax machine — but the third time was the charm.

Extreme Tire answered right away, clearly explained the next steps, and invited me to bring my vehicle in. When I arrived, I was greeted immediately, and after a brief explanation, their team got straight to work. I was in and out quickly, and the entire experience was seamless.

I’ll definitely return for any future needs. Outstanding customer service — thank you, Extreme Tire & Wheel!

user_reviews.Name: Stick Bikelife
user_reviews.Description:
I stopped in yesterday afternoon, about an hour before closing (which I know is usually the “please don’t walk in right now” hour). Mr. Ahmad was nothing but kind and helpful from the start. He answered every single question I had without making me feel rushed.

I had just bought a truck that day and it was in desperate need of new “shoes.” I told him I wasn’t picky about the style — as long as they were gloss black. He took that simple request and ran with it. Using his expertise, he showed me the perfect wheel and tire setup that completely changed the look of the truck.

He had it in the shop and swapped over in no time. Smooth, quick, no nonsense — exactly how it should be.

I can honestly say this was the best experience I’ve ever had at a rim and tire shop. When you walk in, it feels like more than just a place to buy wheels. It’s one of those spots where you could hang out and talk cars for a while — even if you didn’t plan on staying.

Highly recommend. My truck walked in average and left feeling expensive. 😎

Travis Eaton 🤙

user_reviews.Name: Mo Al
user_reviews.Description:
It’s honestly concerning how some businesses are being run these days. I submitted an online inquiry for tires, selected the exact brand I wanted, and received a call almost immediately—which initially seemed promising.

Unfortunately, the experience went downhill fast. The young girl who called appeared to have little to no knowledge of tire brands or specifications. I repeatedly had to explain basic information about the tires I was requesting, and it felt more like I was educating the employee than being assisted.

After a long and frustrating conversation, I was told the tires weren’t even in stock. When I asked how long it would take to order them, I was told she didn’t know. I then asked if she could check with someone who might know, but there was no effort made to do so.

At that point, it became clear that my time was being wasted. If a business wants to earn customers’ trust—especially when it comes to something as important as working on a vehicle—it needs staff who understand the products they’re selling and can answer basic questions confidently. Otherwise, customer confidence is lost before the service even begins.

I definitely don’t recommend this place for anybody, spend your hard earned dollar somewhere else

user_reviews.Name: Jared Guynes
user_reviews.Description:
This place is an automotive playground. The store is massive with an epic selection that covers just about everything performance related, and the showroom alone is worth the visit. Full-on dragsters hanging from the ceiling, displays everywhere, and a vibe that instantly gets you excited about cars and projects.

The biggest pro tip here is local pickup. You can literally save hundreds of dollars on freight shipping by picking up in Arlington, which is a huge win on big or heavy parts. Add in tons of merch for everyone including kids, and this becomes more than a parts store, it’s an experience. If you’re even remotely into cars, this spot is a must visit.

user_reviews.Name: Gregory Laroche
user_reviews.Description:
I got a lift and 35's put on my dodge 1500 here near the end of last year 2024. It looked good but drove like crap. I took it back up there 2 weeks later asking if they could do anything about it. The guys just took the front tires off and rebalanced them and said good to go. I finally had enough of it and took my truck to another lift shop. They said whoever installed the lift didn't know what they were doing. Adjustment bolts in the wrong spots and backwards. Wheel weights all over like they struggled to balancing the tires. I didn't even want to take it back up there to have them correct it all. Decided to shell out another 1300$ to a more reputable business to have it done the right way like I should have done in the first place.

Besides the poor mechanical skills of installing the lift and tires properly. They were friendly, but I don't recommend using them. This was a big set back for me financially and i also went months without being able to  drive my personal truck.

user_reviews.Name: billy hale
user_reviews.Description:
I wouldn’t recommend this dealership to anyone who actually wants to compare vehicles before making a purchase.

My family and I came here fully intending to buy a truck the same day. We drove an hour because they had several vehicles we were interested in — multiple trucks of the same make/model along with a few comparable options from another brand. Since every used vehicle drives differently, we wanted to narrow down the best one by test driving a few of them. That’s a normal part of shopping for a vehicle.

After only two test drives, we were told we could only drive one more vehicle. That immediately killed the entire buying experience. We weren’t joyriding or wasting anyone’s time — we were serious buyers trying to make an informed decision on a major purchase.

What made the situation even more frustrating was the mixed messaging. As we were leaving, they repeatedly asked if we wanted to test drive another vehicle, while at the same time acting irritated that we wanted to compare options in the first place. If there’s a strict limit on what customers are “allowed” to test drive before spending thousands of dollars, that should be stated upfront.

The owner’s response to other reviews only reinforces the issue. Expecting customers to drive one Toyota and one Nissan and assume the other trucks on the lot will feel identical is unrealistic, especially with used vehicles where condition, maintenance, mileage, tires, suspension, and wear can make a huge difference.

The online reviews and the experience we had in person did not match at all. We expected professionalism and patience from a dealership trying to earn a sale. Instead, we left feeling rushed and unwelcome despite being ready to buy.

Would not return.

user_reviews.Name: Teresa Coit
user_reviews.Description: DO NOT BUY FROM HERE. I bought a 2015 Hyundai Sonata in Feb 2026, and it didn't even last a month. By March, I was getting two oil changes in 30 days because of a major leak. When the engine light started flashing, the codes for the camshaft and knock sensor showed up as ‘stored,’ meaning the dealership likely cleared the lights to hide the issues from me. I paid to replace the knock sensor myself, but the engine light stayed on and the engine is now failing. When I went back for help, the salesman was basically telling my boyfriend that they already had our money and since it was ‘as-is,’ they didn't care. He tried to send us to a mechanic next door who just happened to be ‘leaving’ the second we pulled up. They had a Carfax in the window, but after doing my own digging, things are not adding up. They clearly patched up a dying engine with a temporary fix just to get it off the lot. Absolutely ridiculous and dishonest business. BTW Hyundai stated my engine is failing tremendously. I’m fine with the car being as is but when things are not adding up and things that are major that are happening too soon I’m already knowing something ain’t right like getting the tires rotated or getting the tires changed or getting a tuneup that’s understandable but the engine failing and two codes that has something to do with the engine is very weird. Lesson learn

user_reviews.Name: Jscott
user_reviews.Description: First of I’m blessed by finding this place. I can’t say enough of the very kind and honest employees at Big Tex. The last few years I had lost so much due to having cancer. I literally was losing everything I owned and worked hard for due to chemotherapy and radiation treatments for my cancer. I couldn’t afford a lot when I was in treatment. I begged and pleaded for a lil help. Just give me a lil time I’ll have the payment!! But life goes on and bills need to be paid. The only person that would help me was Mrs Sandra at big Tex. She actually stopped payments for me to get back to feeling well so I could work and pay my truck note and other bills. This lady doesn’t know me. I don’t know her on any personal level. But here she was supporting me and telling me that don’t worry about the truck. Worry about your health. I know not all knows the pain ,anguish, and stress of having Cancer. But I’m here to say that just a lil of sympathy, compassion, and most of all KINDNESS goes a long ways. I will always be thankful and grateful for Mrs. Sandra. Here I am 3 years later in remission but still fighting everyday. I know that without my truck I wouldn’t be able to get to my therapy, my job and pick my kids up. From my heart and everything I have THANK YOU SANDRA!!! I know you say your doing your job. But you touched my life with your kindness. Without your help I would have lost everything….now I have my life back and I’m grateful and always will pay it forward.. I will never buy another car or truck from anywhere else. I promise if you buy a vehicle there you won’t go anywhere else after.!!  You will feel the difference when you go there. I promise you guys go there first and you won’t go anywhere else.

user_reviews.Name: Jeff P
user_reviews.Description:
I purchased my car from Auto City over 9 months ago and have always been a loyal customer who pays on time and maintains full coverage insurance. When I bought the car, I provided my insurance policy, which was accepted without issue.
Six months later, when it came time to re-verify coverage, nothing had changed on my policy. However, the dealership suddenly refused to accept it, claiming that having an excluded driver (my husband) on the policy was no longer acceptable—even though they had previously approved it. They told me I would either need to remove him (which my insurance company cannot do), downgrade to liability, or purchase their own COI insurance in addition to my full coverage. I was not willing to downgrade my personal insurance.

During this dispute, I attempted to make my car payments, but the dealership refused to accept them online. They added the insurance fee to my payment portal, preventing me from paying my actual car payment unless I included their insurance fee. This forced me to call in and pay over the phone, which was both frustrating and unfair. At one point, they even refused to take my payment over the phone until I agreed to purchase their insurance. Because I pushed back, I fell behind a month, and they repossessed my car—claiming “no insurance” and “non-payment of the car note.”

The most discouraging part was my conversation with General Manager Sarah Arellano. She stated that the reason my husband could not be on my insurance policy was because he was a “risk.” I explained that she is not an insurance professional, does not have his driving information, and has no authority to make that determination. Despite my efforts to resolve the issue, including my insurance company reaching out directly to her, calls went unanswered or were made outside of business hours.

When I asked what I could do to get my car back, I was told they no longer wanted to do business with me. After faithfully paying for over 9 months without ever being late, I was denied the opportunity to continue.

This experience shows a lack of consistency, transparency, and respect for customers. I believe leadership should act in the best interest of the company, not based on personal feelings. Unfortunately, this dealership’s practices are misleading and unfair.

Do not purchase from this dealership.

They offer in-house financing, asked only for basic documents, and gave me a real opportunity. I drove off with the keys to a very well-kept luxury vehicle, which I’ll be paying off in just over 2 years.

Huge thanks to MJ Said, who answered all my questions and even helped me find fast insurance service. The process was quick, respectful, and stress-free. I’m extremely grateful there are still businesses that truly care. I only wish they had a Happy Customer Facebook page so we could share photos and show how thankful we are for their excellent service. Highly recommended!

user_reviews.Name: Frank Munoz
user_reviews.Description:
Had a good experience with them at first... My first car went out they made it right and got me into a second vehicle. But shortly after started having transmission issues. The dealership was informed of the issues with the transmission before the warranty expired and they knew I only had 1 vehicle but they needed to keep that car for almost a week to fix but I would have been out of work for a week as well. They stated get a second vehicle and we could fix the bad transmission. I couldnt afford another car but after a couple of weeks I was finally able to use a second vehicle and all of a sudden the issue was not covered under warranty any more and now I'm stuck with a car that won't move or start. They delayed and delayed until expiration. I have been a customer for almost 2 years and have never missed a payment but get treated this way is unfair and not professional. No issues with sales but major issue with maintenance department and a certain manager. 6 months ago I would have referred my own mother to this place but now that I see they care only to get you money but don't care about anything else when something goes wrong with your car I don't recommend my worst enemy to get a car from this establishment.
1st car Chevy cruze
2nd car Kia sorrento

user_reviews.Name: Shaundra D
user_reviews.Description:
The process was straightforward, quick, and convenient. Victor and Fred were excellent to work with, and we also met the general manager, who was just as friendly and transparent. We are satisfied with our purchase and the overall experience.

A customer came in before us and was interested in the exact vehicle we were—they left to think about it with no deposit or guarantees. They treated us with the same respect and allowed us to test drive and discuss pricing. When the same customer returned to purchase, the manager prioritized us since we were already starting the paperwork. Unfortunately, as a black couple, we anticipated being told the prior customer had priority, but this didn't happen.

We were treated fairly and without regard for our appearance. We were serious buyers with “cash in hand” and treated as such.

I waited a week to share a review. We flew to Dallas and drove the vehicle back a little over six hours. We’ve also driven a few hours out of state with no issues since the purchase..

Don’t walk here—run! Thank you for the fantastic service. We would purchase from you again.

Transparency—We’ve noticed a few bumps, bruises, and minor inconveniences that were not pointed out to us at POS, and it took them about 20 minutes to acknowledge our existence when we arrived (they apologized).

user_reviews.Name: AFAQ MOTIWALA
user_reviews.Description:
I recently took my Mercedes-Benz GLS to Elite Auto on Harry Hines, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Since it’s a European vehicle, I was honestly very nervous about where to take it — but these guys completely exceeded my expectations.

They are extremely professional and clearly have strong experience working on European cars. The quality of their work and customer service is better than many big-name shops I’ve dealt with in the past. What really stood out to me was their honesty. Multiple other body shops insisted that my lift gate needed to be replaced, which would have been very expensive. Elite Auto, on the other hand, took the time to actually assess the damage and recommended repairing it instead — saving me a significant amount of money.

The repair work itself was outstanding. The dent was fixed perfectly, and the car looks fantastic. No shortcuts, no pressure, just honest advice and excellent craftsmanship.

It’s hard to find a shop you can truly trust, especially for luxury or European vehicles, but Elite Auto has earned mine. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality, integrity, and top-tier service.

user_reviews.Name: Juno
user_reviews.Description:
Professional, Efficient, and Fair – Better than the Dealership!

I recently had running boards installed on my Acura MDX at Elite Auto Body Shop, and the experience was flawless from start to finish.

After receiving a quote from the dealership, I was shocked by their pricing—they are truly out of their mind with those estimates. Following a high recommendation from a co-worker who had great results with their body work here, I decided to give Elite a try. It was the right decision.

Key Highlights:
• Speed: The entire process took less than 3 hours.
• Service: Kuba, the operator, is incredibly friendly and focuses on building genuine customer connections. It’s rare to find that level of thoughtfulness.
• Value: Unlike the dealership, Kuba provided a very fair price and did not overcharge.

If you want smooth, honest service and professional installation without the "dealership tax," I highly recommend Elite Auto Body Shop. I highly recommend their service over any dealership alternative.

This was my first experience at Elite Auto Body Shop, and I’m truly glad I gave them a chance. After a collision left my bumper dragging, I searched for the nearest body shop and decided to give them a try. From the moment I walked in, they were incredibly swift, professional, and helpful.

Even though I brought my car in close to closing time, they went out of their way to make sure I was taken care of and that my car was recovered promptly. Kuba and the rest of the team were extremely knowledgeable, friendly, and transparent throughout the entire process. They clearly explained which parts needed attention, what additional services were recommended, and why— all at a very reasonable price.

I got my car back in pristine condition faster than I expected, and they greeted me with the same kindness when I picked it up. I highly recommend giving them your business. I’ll absolutely be returning for any future repairs. Huge thank you to Kuba and the entire team!

user_reviews.Description: As a woman, it is always stressful going to do anything for your car because there have been so many times that I've been screwed or attempted to be. On top of this, he called enterprise and got me a huge discount on my rental car. Everyone that worked there was so kind and made great conversation with me as well. I felt like I was being looked after on top of my car getting taken care of. I hope I never have to use them again (no more accidents),  but if I do need an autobody shop, I will 100% come back here and I recommend them to my friends/family.

user_reviews.Name: Tracy Civick
user_reviews.Description:
I took my 2022 Dodge Ram in December 2024 after backing into a light-post in a parking lot. The bumper needed replacement. I researched online and selected a few body shops to give me quotes based on reviews. The quotes were similar but Catherine was able to see my vehicle right away.

Upon my visit, there was the exact same model truck with front end damage. They were able to replace my bumper with that vehicle lower than the quoted price and the workmanship was excellent, plus it was done within 24 hours (photos attached). This saved me a days worth of car rental. On top of that they gave me a ride to the car rental place.

Due to this positive experience I returned a few weeks later to see if they could look at my spouse's Volvo. The dealership quoted us over $1K to fix a dent in the rear hatch. I asked if they could pop it out, and they quoted me $200 as it would take a few hours (basically for labor). I said to move forward and waited in the lobby area. 15 minutes later they came back with the dent fixed letting me know they didn't have to remove the frame as expected. Then they told me this was free of charge!

Incredible service, honesty, and great work. This spot is a gem and they've earned a loyal customer.

user_reviews.Name: Marc Nunez
user_reviews.Description:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I’m leaving Compean Autos in Dallas and I can honestly say they did an outstanding job. I was extremely impressed with the quality of their work and, just as important, how flexible and helpful they were throughout the entire process.
A big thank you to Catherine and Victor, who were both amazing to work with. They were professional, communicative, and truly went above and beyond to make sure everything was handled correctly. They even helped me with my warranty claims, which made the process smooth and stress-free.
The polish and buff they did on my truck was incredible — the truck looks beautiful, smooth, and extremely glossy. I had previously taken my truck to another shop, Texas Collision, and while the paint job looked okay at first, I later noticed overspray on the rear passenger side, specifically above the back fender near the rear tire and on the right side of the rear windshield. I didn’t fully realize how noticeable it was until Compean Autos polished the truck and brought out the true finish.
What really sets Compean Autos apart is that they were kind enough to fix those previous shop’s mistakes at no extra cost, which says a lot about their integrity and pride in their work.
If you’re looking for a shop that truly cares about their customers and delivers high-quality results, I highly recommend Compean Autos. They exceeded my expectations in every way.

user_reviews.Name: Serotonin Shawty
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Review for Fusion Kitchen in Richardson

I came to Fusion Kitchen for a birthday kickback on a Sunday afternoon and the whole experience was really nice. The food was good, the vibes were on point, and the decor and ambiance fit the mood perfectly. The staff was friendly and the owner even gifted our table a round of top shelf shots while promoting his upcoming events which made everything feel personal and welcoming.

My plate had highs and lows. The oxtails were the star for me. They were long cut, stewed to perfection, and the broth was so good I took it home. The greens had a good smoky flavor and the eggrolls had no meat but the sauce helped them out. The mac and cheese was my only real criticism. It tasted more like a Kraft-style base with cheese baked on top. Once I added some of that delicious oxtail broth it instantly elevated the flavor which made me wish I would have just ordered a full oxtail plate from the start.

Overall I enjoyed my time here. The service, the atmosphere, and those oxtails alone make it worth coming back. I would recommend it for a chill kickback or a casual dinner or brunch. Sam was our waitress and she was AMAZING!

user_reviews.Name: Angie Thomas
user_reviews.Description:
My husband and I were the first guests to arrive for the Valentine’s Day special event. We booked this experience specifically because the event was advertised as including unlimited drinks and a live performance by SWV.

Upon arrival, we were seated in a section designated as VIP. However, we were later informed that at 11:00 PM we would need to vacate our table because SWV would be seated in that section. Shortly after, we were also told that the “unlimited drinks” advertised had now been reduced to only four drinks per person.
Not to mention the ladies restroom was not functional they had plumbers there working on the restroom during a packed audience.

Another couple seated next to us expressed the same concerns. When I questioned the owner about the change, he stated that due to TABC laws they could not offer unlimited drinks. However, this contradicts what was clearly advertised. If there were legal limitations, that should have been communicated upfront rather than changing the terms after guests had already paid and arrived. The advertisement felt misleading, and it was unfair to collect payment under one promise and deliver something entirely different.

The discussion escalated unnecessarily, as the owner began arguing with both myself and another guest regarding the advertisement. Following that exchange, service noticeably declined. Drinks and appetizers took an excessive amount of time to arrive. As more guests arrived, many voiced similar frustrations regarding the misleading promotion.

The entire evening felt chaotic and uncomfortable. Some guests did not receive their food at all and were told the restaurant had run out of salmon, which was listed as a featured entrée. However, approximately 45 minutes later, I personally observed a server delivering a salmon entrée to another table.

Overall, this was not the romantic, organized Valentine’s experience that was advertised or expected. We left feeling extremely disappointed. This is not a venue we would recommend for a special occasion, particularly one as meaningful as Valentine’s Day.

user_reviews.Description:
# Review of the February 14th Valentine's Day Dinner Featuring SWV

This review pertains to the Valentine's Day dinner held on February 14th, which featured a special appearance by SWV. As many have mentioned, the meal service was quite chaotic. On a positive note, the band TMarsh was fantastic and truly maintained a lively atmosphere; we thoroughly enjoyed their performance. The DJ also did a commendable job.

The lounge area was beautifully set up and decorated, and we were absolutely delighted with our table location. SWV made their appearance as promised, which was a highlight. The staff remained incredibly polite and composed, despite the pressure and chaos surrounding the food situation. They held it together admirably. Therefore, I give Fusion some credit for their effort.
Mostly likely we will think 2x before a revisit but its not completely off the table. Hopefully, they will regroup and move forward. We actually like the place.

user_reviews.Name: Vee ET
user_reviews.Description:
I had an excellent experience with Enterprise Rent-A-Car at Dallas Love Field, Texas from start to finish. From the moment I walked in, the level of customer service immediately stood out in the best way.

Tee was phenomenal right from the beginning. She was polite, welcoming, and incredibly attentive without ever making the process feel rushed or overwhelming. She took the time to make sure everything was clearly explained, answered every question with patience, and genuinely made the pickup experience smooth and stress-free. It’s rare to feel that kind of consistent professionalism paired with warmth, but she absolutely delivered that.

Manager Tony also made a big impact on our experience. He went out of his way to ensure we were placed in a great vehicle that fit our needs, and we ended up with a Nissan Rogue that was clean, comfortable, and exactly what we were hoping for. You could tell he genuinely cared about making sure customers left satisfied and confident in their rental.

The return process was just as pleasant thanks to Claudia. She was so kind, sweet, and welcoming at drop-off. Even though returns are usually quick and routine, she still took the time to be personable and appreciative, which left a lasting positive impression and made the experience feel complete rather than transactional.

Overall, this location truly stands out for its team. Every person we interacted with was professional, kind, and efficient, and the entire process—from pickup to return—was seamless. We will absolutely be renting again from this location and highly recommend it to anyone flying through Love Field.

user_reviews.Name: Devona Verdeja
user_reviews.Description: Alamo provided better customer service than their competitor's! I took a shuttle from Dallas Love Field airport and was unable to get a vehicle from my prepaid reservation at my original rental agency. Keep in mind I had spoken to a customer service agent, a week prior, to ensure all information was updated and that my rental process was straight forward. Arrived at Budget, only to be denied and not given a straight forward answer as to why. I was confused because I had just rented with them 4 months ago without a problem. The staff told me I had a reservation with Costco, which I thought I had canceled. When I informed the staff I had a prepaid reservation, the person argued with me, stating that there wasn't a prepaid reservation. Finally, the staff looked up the confirmation number, instead of renting me the vehicle he gave me a number to customer service. So after being denied and talking with customer service, who was also confused as to why I was being denied, I asked for a refund and walked over to National/Alamo. Apparently, once Budget denies a reservation, there is no way to change it in the system. At Natonal/Alamo rental agency, I was helped immediately with professional, and friendly service! I will definitely use Alamo in the future! The vehicle was super clean and appeared to be well maintained. I'll never rent with Budget again!!

user_reviews.Name: Sherif
user_reviews.Description:
Went in on Thanksgiving to pick up my car, and the lady up front seemed very nice. Didn’t have any issues with her, and I understood the policy with being a young driver and the fees, etc. She informed me about being limited to the cars I could drive being 21 and showed me the cars I could drive. I told her my situation about whether it was going to be my mother or me who would have driven, so I just wanted to see what cars they did have until my mother had arrived. She then offered to let me go see the cars out in the lot. As I go out and look at the cars I could have driven, I also looked at a few others because she said I could go out and look at all the other cars… I look at one “luxury” vehicle, and another lady comes out with an attitude saying if you didn’t reserve the car, you weren’t able to look at it. Okay?? I’m confused as to why she was rude about it after being told I could look at the vehicles, and nowhere did it say it was reserved. I respectfully told her no, we didn’t, and stood outside for a little. She stood out there until we walked in and walked in right after us…. thought it was kind of weird but ignored it.
As I’m waiting for my mother because we weren’t sure who was going to drive, we waited in the lobby until I got a final answer from her. As I told my cousins who were sitting in the lobby as I was looking at the cars, informed me that the lady was pissed and stormed out after she saw we were looking at the “luxury” vehicle, and that’s when she came and told us we weren’t supposed to look at it. I understand I’m under the age of 25 and I’m limited to the cars I can drive, but you didn’t know my situation for you to quickly assume something and think I wasn’t going to be able to drive that car being under her mom. If anything, my mother could have rented out that car and driven it. But the car was small anyways, so it wouldn’t have worked out. As I’m waiting, the lady who had told us we couldn’t look at the luxury vehicle was whispering to her coworker, “I hope she knows she won’t be able to drive that car if it’s under her mom, ” and just kept on saying unnecessary things as if I wasn’t informed about it and didn’t have ANY issue with what car I was going to drive if it were to be under my name. If she had an issue, she could have simply talked to me about it instead of being a messy grown lady chatting to her coworker lol. I was respectful, didn’t have any issues going in, and didn’t have any attitude towards her whatsoever, so I’m confused as to why she was so rude about this whole situation. I ended up renting a car under my name, and from there, everything went smoothly.  The lady who was being rude was happy to assist all these other people with respect, but when it came to me, she was rude?? This was my first time renting a car with Alamo, and it was just a weird experience having to deal with someone who had some weird animosity towards me and no respect. This whole situation was so unnecessary and pointless. I’m not sure what her issue was.

user_reviews.Description:
Would give 0 stars if I could. Please save yourself a headache and do not rent from here. There is no signage for the outdoor kiosk that is a shuttle distance away from the airport terminal desk. When I returned the car, they charged me for gas when I filled up a mile from the airport. Total nightmare.

user_reviews.Name: A Bates
user_reviews.Description:
DO NOT PRE-PAY FOR RENTAL!  I pre-paid for a luxury car a Caddie or similar about 3 or 4 weeks prior to my trip.   I flew to Dallas Love FLD on Feb 23rd.  I arrived at Budget, while waiting in line.  One of the people at the counter was picking up a car.  He said, oh this says I'm getting a Denali.  The clerk said no, that's not the car you are getting.  The customer then says, the upgrade is free, right.
They finish, I go to the counter.  I'm told all they have in the luxury group is a Denli.  I said ok. I was not happy, but said ok.   I walked outside and there is a Mercedes at the door.  I see the guy from the counter who get into it.  Yes, I'm pissed at this point.

I walk all the way across the lot with luggage to find this enormous SUV they expect me to take.  I walk back inside and tell them it's not going to work.
They say it's all they have.  I very loudly tell them sure it is!  You gave my car away to the other guy, right in front of me!    That I rented a month ago.
They tell me I can get a Transverse.  I told them in what reality is a Chevy a luxury car?  They told me the maker considers it thier luxury vehicle.  Sure they do.  The public does not.

More devices and electronics do not make a vehicle luxury!  Those things are fluff to increase the cost of the vehicle.

I do not want a vehicle telling me a bag is a passenger in the back seat!  Or looks like a police car inside.
I wanted a very plush comfortable car that was pleasing interior and very smooth ride.  Something to make my mom comfortable, relaxed, and at ease during this difficult time.

PRE PAYING MAY GET YOU A DISCOUNT, BUT IT DOES NOT RESERVE THE VEHICLE YOU PAID FOR!

Be careful because you may not be getting the class of car you reserve.
And Budget will breach the contract yet hold you to paying the higher price!

Being cheaper now days seems to really mean more expensive in the long run.   Acting like they are doing you a favor by giving a discount for pr-paying.  When in reality the discount is to lure you into giving them money before they earn it.  Without giving you anything in return.  It's a scam.

It leads to them breaching the contract while charging you more and get less! It's an unfair bait and switch scheme.

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Mundy
user_reviews.Description:
I had an extremely disappointing experience with Budget Rental Car due to poor employee behavior and lack of communication.

The first employee who assisted us seemed annoyed that we were even there and was not polite or attentive. Every time another employee walked by, she would stop listening to us mid-sentence and begin a separate conversation with them. On top of that, our final bill ended up being about $100 more than the online price, and she never informed us of any changes or additional charges being made.

She told us we would receive a text with a QR code to exit the lot, which never came. When I went back to ask her about it, her response was simply, “That’s okay.” I then had to ask how I was supposed to leave the lot, at which point she told me I could simply use my license to exit, even though she had previously made it seem as though the QR code was the only way to leave.

When we finally reached the exit gate, the attendant there was also unfriendly. She informed us—only at that point—that the reservation had somehow been switched to my mom’s name instead of mine, and that I was not allowed to drive the car off the lot. She explained that the additional driver could drive after leaving the lot, but not out of the lot, which made no sense and had never been communicated earlier.

As she handed my license back, I was in the process of exiting the vehicle to switch drivers. After I got into the passenger seat, she accused me of “snatching” my license from her, which was completely untrue and unprofessional.

Overall, this was a terrible experience from start to finish. The only positive part was the shuttle driver from the airport to the Budget rental office—he was the only employee who was kind and professional. Unfortunately, that was not enough to make up for the rest of the experience. I would not recommend this location.

Don’t rent from here.

user_reviews.Name: HB D
user_reviews.Description:
Avoid this rental car location!
I would never recommend Avis at Dallas Love Field airport to anyone based on the unpleasant  and unprofessional customer service I experienced. The heavyset representative with lamb-chop eyelashes who assisted me at pickup spent 10 minutes sharing a  personal story with customer ahead of me while the line contiued to grow with customers. When it was my turn to be assisted she was rude and unwelcoming from the start as if it was an inconvenience to her to assist me. Her attitude became more hostile when I declined the additional insurance and worsened after I confirmed that i did not want any coverage. Suddenly she didn't have the elite standard size suv that I had prepaid for via priceline.com. She kept asking me how passengers I would have traveling with me. I am not sure why that mattered but she tried to give me a smaller car until I insisted that I would only accept the car type that I prepaid for.  She called someone who told her the car type and size that I prepaid was available and they would bring to the front.
The rude, unpleasant tone and beratement continued when she snapped at me for removing my credit card from the card reader before she told me to do so.
I would have walked out without picking up the car if it wasn't prepaid and a necessity.
Tonight I returned the car with a full tank but just received a receipt for a charge of $58.32 because I was given the car with 18.8 gallons of fuel and returned it with 18.7 gallons of fuel.

user_reviews.Name: Gilberto Mazmanyan
user_reviews.Description:
One of the absolute WORST experiences with a car rental company. The front staff is terrible - zero customer service. The electric car was given to us with 33% charge and it was filthy. It was disgusting. It had not been cleaned or charged prior to it being given to us. Called immediately to let them know, and they said they'd extend the return time and return it at the same charge. However, upon returning the car in the same condition it was given to us and same level of charge, they proceeded to charge us a "fuel fee" for almost $20. Had to call corporate to file a formal complaint and get that bogus charge reversed.

UPDATE: I emailed them.like they asked in their reply and literally got nothing but reiterate why I had already said about being refunded. Pointless. At least offer a free rental or SOMETHING to take care of a loyal customer.

user_reviews.Name: Ran Zeng
user_reviews.Description:
We had a confirmed, prepaid reservation made weeks in advance. On the scheduled pickup day, when our hotel stay had ended and we needed the car to begin a planned road trip, we were informed that the location had no cars available.

A reservation that has already been charged should guarantee a vehicle. Instead, we were left without transportation and given no advance notice.

What was most disappointing was the lack of assistance. We asked whether they could check inventory at other nearby locations and were told they could not. No effort was made to secure a replacement vehicle, offer alternatives, or provide any form of compensation. We were left to solve the problem ourselves under significant time pressure.

Running out of cars is a serious operational issue. Failing to offer support when it happens reflects poorly on customer service standards and ethics.

If you have travel plans and would like a hassle free experience, I would strongly reconsider relying on this location, as reading other reviews, my experience is not a standalone incident. I wish I’ve done more thorough research to avoid this stressful situation we put ourselves into, but if you are reading this, it may not be too late for you.

user_reviews.Name: Mitchell Phipps
user_reviews.Description:
This entire experience with Hertz has been a nightmare. First, I made a reservation at a different location and after checking online and receiving my confirmation message and checking before arriving, I was still told that there were no cars available. I had a job interview that day that was very important and I even gave myself three hours to get there, but I was told by corporate when I called that they had to guarantee me a car within an hour of my reservation time per the policy. The guy at the front desk told me that “it is what it is” and  they may not have the car at any point in the daytime so it wasn’t worth me waiting around for one.
So he gives me a number for corporate at Hertz and the lady on the phone tells me the only way she can help me is for me to sign up for a Hertz gold membership. So I waste more time signing up for this membership and then having to call back for the corporate number again to ask for help, they eventually find a new location which is on Ross Avenue and they ask me to take another $45 Uber to that location. She sets the appointment time for 15 minutes from our phone conversation even though it takes 25 minutes to get there.
So I arrive and the guy at the front desk says “Man I’m not sure we have that car available” and after much pleading and waiting, by the grace of God, a car was returned early and I was able to take it. The car reeked of curry and was obviously not clean, but I had to take it as I was already one hour late for my job interview.
The front desk staff at both locations were definitely in poor morale due to the companies failing financials and mismanagement. It really isn’t even their fault. I felt bad for them. It’s clear that there is a direct correlation to the falling stock prices and what is happening internally in the company with their training processes.
Oh, but rest assured, I checked on the availability of purchasing a car, and I was called immediately by their sales department, so it’s clear they’re trying to make as much money as they can by selling off the cars yet they don’t have any availability for the renters. Hertz is in bad shape. It doesn’t matter which location I would recommend finding a different provider . To make matters worse, no one calls at the locations and corporate can’t help you much as far as extending reservations or modifying drop offs. So they’re virtually is no customer service and they leave it up to each location and the poor guys and gals are so overwhelmed they have no time to answer the phones.

user_reviews.Name: Leaving Comments
user_reviews.Description: Everything about this place needs to go. The service is slower than molasses in January. During our visit they only had one staff on duty with a lobby of 7 customers! We reserved our rental weeks in advance, only to have to wait 45 minutes to even reach the counter and begin the rental process. I looked up reviews while waiting for this awfully slow service, and was immediately nervous about the possibility of the car I would get. I was sure to take numerous photos of the vehicle we received, including video recording for my own records. I wanted to be sure I had ample evidence shall anything go wrong with the customer service since other reviews mentioned how terrible it is and how they lie on their customers about the condition of the rentals when returned. I will say the one staff that was on duty, Mike, did his job with a smile on his face. I commend him for that because Hertz clearly doesn’t know how to maintain a professional business with employees who show up to work. They are extremely blessed to have Mike on their staff. I’ve rented from other Hertz locations before, and recommend they close this location and do a completely overall of operations, staffing, vehicles, and customer service!

user_reviews.Name: Frank Miller
user_reviews.Description:
After standing in line in the airport for about 20 minutes because my Fastbreak number wasn’t working, I finally got a car assigned to me. It was supposed to be in H6, but when the shuttle got to row H, there was only an SUV in H5, with no keys. The rest of Row H was empty. The driver told me to stand by the building, and someone would bring a car to me. After about 10 minutes passed with no car coming, I went inside to complain, but they were lined up so long that I gave up that idea. I flagged down a couple of lot workers, and one guy grabbed a Toyota SUV and ran it through the car wash for me. The inside was still dirty and the touchscreen was covered with fingerprints, but I didn’t complain. Toyotas are foreign to me (pun intended) so the controls were all strange to me. By this time, I was running late for my appointment. The touchscreen was unreadable so I had to drive with one hand while holding my phone with the other to get directions to my appointment about an hour away. After my meeting, I had time to fool with the touchscreen and found the brightness had been turned all the way down.  I had Apple CarPlay working for a while, and then suddenly the screen prompted me to create an account. Why, who knows? No more response to pressing anything on the touchscreen. No more CarPlay, no more map, back to holding the phone once again.
Time to get rid of this thing. I go to a gas station, get the pump going only to find the gas door doesn’t open until I find the secret button. After hunting for a button on the dash and console, I find it down by my left foot. Then I have to restart the pump once again.
So this was not a fun experience. On the plus side, it did have four wheels, it started every time, and it went forward and reverse. All in all, I prefer National. Just grab your car of choice and go.

I am a senior citizen, I had a hour of driving to do when I got to Dallas. Did not want to spend the night in the airport, I was returning 48 hours after my original arrival time. So my choice was hope another car rental could help or cancel the entire trip.

On top of this, do not know if I will get my money back. 48 to 72 hours to come up with a resolution.

user_reviews.Name: Anne
user_reviews.Description: I have booked with Budget many times in the past and made this reservation on 11/30. I called the morning of at 12/11 at 10:38AM at the Budget location in Dallas on Commerce to see if I could pick up one of the vehicles early and the guy I talked to said no, which is unusual. So we waited about an hour and went over there and he told me that there were no vehicles available and there  more might arrive in about an hour. Absolutely unbelievable. I am positive this employee knew by 10:38AM that they were out of cars and didn’t bother to tell me and made me come all the way there in person just to tell me that face to face. Unwilling to trust this guy and wait and HOPE more cars show up in hour, we had no choice but to book with another car rental agency all the way back at the DFW. It was a huge waste of our vacation time and money - we basically lost an entire day because of it. Is this how Budget does business with its loyal customers? Shameful.

user_reviews.Name: T
user_reviews.Description: The woman at the DFW counter was nice. (I didn’t write her name down) I went in with a reservation for a vehicle that was described as extraordinary and special. During the check in she congratulated me on an upgrade to a Mercedes C300. Well I figured it would be a Mercedes or BMW since that’s all Sixt shows in their marketing. But the car wasn’t special or extraordinary. It was a base C300 that only fit two suitcases in the trunk. We had three. The car was in ok condition. The wheels were scuffed and the paint was dull and waterspotted. The car wash streaks were obvious. It was a 2025 with 13k miles on it. I myself waxed it and shined it. Cleaned up the wheels and tires before I drove it around town. I like a car to look fresh. Which is EXACTLY how I returned it. I still don’t know if they overcharged me since she took another $350 after I had paid in advance. I better not get any bills for damage since I returned it in better condition than I got it. The staff was great and helpful. I give 4 stars because the car I got didn’t meet what my reservation classified the car as (extraordinary/special) It was a base front wheel drive C300.

user_reviews.Name: Alli Yu
user_reviews.Description:
So this is a hard 1 to review.  The price was great but the Checkin & return lines are horrendous!

By far the longest line for Checkin.  I even tried downloading the app but it didn't help.  We waited 30min to an hour to get to a customer service person. When we finally get there, it moved fast since I did my stuff online.   Definitely need more workers or something to move the line.

The cars were nice.  We got an upgrade but the ticket said it was in spot 39 and it was not.  I just clicked until I heard my car make a sound.  We were in 38z. No one was around to ask for help so luckily it wasn't hard.

We had no issues with our car though the last day before our return, our car started saying take in soon for oil change??   Ummm.  That should have been taken care of before.  What if I had more days?  No idea.

As for the return, thank goodness we were early.   Sixt returns held up the whole ramp and even made it hard for all the other car rental folks.  It was jammed back!  Usually, you would drive up to the front for your return.  It was backed all the way to the end.  We literally again waited 30min +to do a return.  Wow!!!

They even said this was the bigger location.  Has potential but needs a lot of work!!

user_reviews.Name: E
user_reviews.Description:
I’ve been a loyal National customer for over 25 years, and my experience at the DFW Airport location today perfectly reinforced why I continue to choose National time and time again.

I want to specifically recognize Alyssa, who went above and beyond when I realized I had lost my primary credit card. What could have been a stressful delay was handled with calm professionalism and genuine care. Alyssa quickly worked with me to use an alternate card and had me checked in immediately—no frustration, no judgment, just outstanding service. That kind of composure and customer-first mindset is rare and deeply appreciated.

I’d also like to thank Angela for stepping in to assist and for providing clear, helpful directions so I could get exactly where I needed to go. Watching Alyssa and Angela work together was a perfect example of teamwork done right—efficient, friendly, and seamless.

This location is excellent, but today’s experience truly solidified my loyalty. Service like this isn’t accidental—it’s cultural. National continues to set the standard, and the DFW team embodies everything I’ve come to expect over the last 25 years.

Outstanding people. Outstanding service. Well done.

user_reviews.Name: James Fornabaio
user_reviews.Description:
Extremely disappointing experience with Hertz today.
When I arrived at the DFW Hertz Gold Garage to pick up my car, there were no vehicles available—just a long line of customers waiting with no staff present to explain the situation. Cars slowly trickled in, and people had to take whatever happened to show up next.  I waited in line for over an hour.
At the exit gate, many customers discovered that the only cars available were more expensive than what they originally reserved. They then had to reverse out of the exit lane and return the car, causing even more confusion and forcing everyone else in line to back up as well.
This was chaotic, poorly managed, and far below the level of service I expect from Hertz. A staff member even told me that this happens every Tuesday at DFW, which is completely unacceptable.
Hertz needs to address this operational issue immediately.

user_reviews.Name: Chris Maier
user_reviews.Description:
I think I'm finally done with Hertz...

This was the second poor experience I’ve had with Hertz in the course of just two weeks (see Hertz CLE review).  As I stated in that review, the problems I continue to experience seem to be a recurring theme among all Hertz locations and indicative of the systemic demise of their operations as a whole.

For this rental, as I approached the exit gate, I noticed the fuel gauge wasn’t completely full.  Now, aren’t we all threatened as renters to make sure these things are totally full or we’ll be charged some ridiculous amount per gallon to have them top it off?  I guess that didn’t apply to the previous renter of this vehicle.  It looked like it was at least a couple of gallons low (verified when I refilled it prior to my return).  I mentioned it to the gate attendant who seemed indifferent about the problem and said that it was “close enough to the ‘F’ and was OK” - and that it just “wasn’t overfull.”  Wait, WHAT?  I thought she was joking…  Again, she told me to take a picture so I could return it with the same ‘lack of fuel’ and basically get away with it.  Again, WHAT IN THE WORLD??

The cherry on top was when I was driving from the airport and used the windshield washer – immediately got a “Washer Fluid Low” warning.  ARE YOU KIDDING ME?  The rental I had just the week before was completely out of fluid when I drove out of the lot (mind you, in snowy/wet conditions – can you say safety issue, Hertz?).

At least this car was brand new and didn’t have a chance to start smelling like pot yet – give it time, I guess…

Needless to say, I returned the car with a full tank and didn't try to match the amount given to me as the exit gate attendant suggested.  The return attendant was very courteous and understanding of the issues but seemed to hint at the fact that this was NOT unusual and something they are accustomed to hearing.  (Enter systemic issues..)

Again, I DO fill out their surveys after these rentals as well.  Do I hear anything back?  Nope...  Could they acknowledge the issues with a simple discount?  Nope...  Are things progressively getting worse?  Yep...

I’ve continued to use Hertz because of their partnership with Delta and the benefits I receive through the SkyMiles Reserve card.  I don't think it's worth it anymore, to be honest.  Having to fill the cars with fluids because they choose not to maintain them is unacceptable.

I think I'm done with Hertz...

user_reviews.Name: Gala R.
user_reviews.Description:
Long story short: I basically spent half of my day on 4/27 exchanging the car because they gave me a bad one.

After waiting over 40 minutes (and being a gold member) they finally gave me the car. Just about an hour after driving to Frisco I saw the floor on the drivers side was soaking wet and there was a squeak when turning the wheel. I called and they told me a tow could pick the car in about 60-90 minutes but they could not deliver the new car to my location and that I had to go back to the Dallas airport to exchange it. I decided to drive myself to avoid the wait.  Once there, the process took over an hour, I parked near the rental center and asked the employee at the Hertz gold desk if he could have someone show me how to get my car to the garage, he had a horrible attitude and said he couldn’t. He didn’t even try to help me even when he saw me struggling and frustrated. Only one of the staff members in the garage wanted to help me, she explained me how to get to the garage so I did. Once there, there were like 30 cars in front of me with people confused and not an employee on sight. I found an employee who told me “he had just clocked in and has no idea what was going on” so I went back to my car until he finally decided to help me. This was a very frustrating experience, if you are renting a car in the Dallas airport choose any other option.

user_reviews.Name: Jeff Talbert
user_reviews.Description:
Horrific. Inexcusable. Rude and incompetent beyond comprehension. Arrived to a lot with no cars and mass confusion amongst employees who were writing names on paper. 8 people waiting on cars. 1 vehicle became available and an employee asked customers how many days they were renting for,as if that mattered. Take care of your priority customers first. I told her 1 day. She told me she had to give the car to a gold member first. I responded,  "I'm PRESIDENTS CIRCLE ". The response?"i have to give it to a gold member first." Doesn't even know her own customer priority levels. I walked to the street and called an Uber. Less convenient,  but necessary on a time sensitive trip. 2 HOURS later I get an email saying I can pick my car from the lot. This is far from the only horrible service and miserable, base model vehicle I've had to endure from this company over the last 2 years. They are pathetic, unprofessional, unprepared and often rude.DAL and MCO are the worst. I will not put up with this again - too many options. Bye, Hertz.

3/1 update.....how utterly classic and ironic that within 3 minutes of posting the review there was an automatic, computer generated, trite and utterly meaningless response from Hertz posted . It screams "we dont care". How utterly typical and completely expected.

user_reviews.Name: Leigh Ann O'Quinn
user_reviews.Description: While I did end up waiting longer than expected for my car, the experience was genuinely positive from start to finish. The team’s attitude made all the difference. They were upbeat, friendly, and incredibly engaging, turning what could have been a frustrating delay into a surprisingly pleasant wait. They kept customers informed, smiled the entire time, and created an environment where no one felt rushed or ignored. It was clear they cared about the customer experience, and that positivity was contagious. I even got to witness one of the employees, Yvette, complimenting her coworkers and showing her appreciation for them. Because of their professionalism and great energy, the wait truly didn’t feel like a wait at all. I would absolutely rent from this location again! Way to go, team!

user_reviews.Name: Jennifer Wold
user_reviews.Description: Kennedy, the customer service rep, was extremely helpful. I had a reservation with a competitor and was paying with a debit card. Turns out if you have a driver's license in the state where you are renting, they won't accept the debit card. It was almost 10:00 at night after a long day of travel. I still had to get to my destination an hour away. I ended up at Hertz and they were wonderful. The rate was a little higher, but she went above and beyond trying to find solutions. It is unlikely that I will go back to the other agency where I have been a customer for over 30 years. I got more compassion and much better service here.

user_reviews.Name: Cynthia McDonald
user_reviews.Description: We've been Presidents Circle members for several years because we like being able to walk up, pick a car, and drive away. This time we were told our rental was not there but 10 minutes away by foot at the private terminal. They told us to go there. Upon arrival we were told that they don't RENT cars there they have Hertz pick up their guests and take them to the place we were just at. But because we weren't flying in on a private jet there was no means. So we had to walk back. The agent at Love Field explained that they had no cars and they can't cancel my reservation because it was past pick up time. After 20 minutes on the phone (after arguing with an AI agent that I wanted to talk to a human) our reservation was modified. I had to argue the new charges as they were charging me $150 more than my reservation. That was finally resolved too. But then we were told to go select a car and all that was on the lot was Kia's and Hyundai SUV's. Very bad selection.

user_reviews.Name: Keith Radebaugh
user_reviews.Description:
This was the worst experience I have ever had with a Hertz rental. When we arrived we were told to proceed to the gold lot as usual. There were no cars in the gold lot. We went inside to ask about it and were told to go back outside and wait as cars were being brought. After waiting about 10 or 15 minutes and seeing other customers that arrived after us receive vehicles, we were told first by the same employee that told us to wait outside and another employee that there was a waiting list inside that we needed to sign up on. A third rude female employee yelled at the another employee and told her that we had ignored her when we arrived and that was why we weren't on the waiting list.

After getting our name in the waiting list, the rude female employee brought me outside and pointed at a vehicle far across the lot and asked if it was acceptable. I simply asked if it was a full size vehicle like we had reserved and were told we would have to wait for a full size vehicle. The helpful female employee shortly later brought us outside and directed us to a different vehicle and indicated we could have it.

After we loaded our luggage and were about to leave, the rude employee came towards our car yelling that we couldn't have that one. We argued with her that the other employee had indicated for us to take that vehicle. After some arguing, she finally agreed to let us take the vehicle.

As a regular Hertz customer, this is the worst experience I have ever had picking up a vehicle. Avoid using hertz at this location. I will.

user_reviews.Name: Nicole Brown
user_reviews.Description: It's hard to find a Dominican salon in Dallas. I am from Atlanta, Ga and there is one on every block! Found this salon when I moved here 5 years ago. I went a few times but stopped. I had forgotten why. After a few years of protective styles, decided to go back. My appointment was at 8am.  When I arrived at 8am, there was no front desk person. There was a young lady doing a sew-in in another room, but it didn't seem like she was a regular employee. The older woman washing hair didn't speak much English. It took about 15 minutes before someone even asked who I was there to see. They told me the stylist (and owner) would be there soon.The stylist didn't show until 8:22. I was giving her until 8:30am before I walked out.  As I remembered, she did great work. And I was not displeased with my hair. She didn't take long to do ny hair, either. I did recall what happened the last time I was there. She had double booked me with another customer. I waited for quite some time to even be seen. I don't really like getting my hair done because I don't like my time being taken advantage of. Some women don't mind. Like I said, the stylist DEFINITELY does good work, but I would suggest a little more punctuality and structure in the salon.

user_reviews.Name: Marteen Landry
user_reviews.Description:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had a really smooth experience with this Enterprise location during what could have been a stressful time after an accident, and I want to acknowledge the team for how professionally everything was handled.

Hunter set up my reservation and walked me through everything clearly, including working with a non-standard insurance situation where only 50% was initially covered. He made the process easy and straightforward from the beginning.

Karrington, the manager, made sure the insurance policy number stayed properly attached to my rental and handled the extensions caused by weather delays and my car not being ready on time. Everything was handled reasonably, without pressure or unnecessary questions.

Joia assisted with transportation to the repair shop when I picked up my vehicle and was professional and kind throughout.

There was also another associate who picked me up from the repair shop when I dropped my car off—I didn’t catch his name—but he was respectful, friendly, and professional, even while I was on the phone handling repair details.

What really stood out was the overall tone of the experience. No guilt, no impatience, and no DMV-type vibes. The team was young but very professional, calm, and accommodating, and they made the entire process feel easy.

I truly appreciate the customer service and professionalism and would absolutely rent from this location (on Polk in Dallas) again.

user_reviews.Name: Tammy Smith
user_reviews.Description:
After someone T-boned my car like they were auditioning for an action movie, my car was completely totaled and my stress level went through the roof. Enter Jamal and Caleb—my unexpected post-crash heroes.

Caleb walked me through the rental process with the calm confidence of someone who deals with panicked, freshly-T-boned humans daily. He explained everything so clearly I almost forgot my car had just been turned into modern art. Jamal, on the other hand, handed me the keys to a rental so nice I questioned why I ever loved my old car in the first place.

They had me squared away faster than my insurance could say ‘we’re still reviewing your claim,’ and honestly made the whole disaster feel weirdly manageable.

If someone ever T-bones your car like they’re playing real-life Mario Kart, go see Jamal and Caleb. Five stars. Highly recommend the service—NOT the accident.

address: 2510 109th St, Grand Prairie, TX 75050, United States

user_reviews.Name: Alexander Sharp
user_reviews.Description: I would recommend Going to another diesel repair shop.   There is a strong lack of communication at this place   And they are  Fully competent when it comes to the trucks that their site says that they service.  I initially had an initial good experience at this place when I was first recommended by after that, it went quickly downhill   My last experience  Was I brought the truck into them for a rear door replacement.  We have a tight service schedule and we do not have a lot of trucks so we can’t afford a lot of downtime and I’ve spoke with the initial guy about doing it over the weekend because he said that they were open.  I also specified to the first guy that I was bringing it in for a door only and I do not need an oil change.  I had just put $300 worth of Titan additives into my engine To help stop the flow of the leaking oil .  Because this place did not have a good solution for the leaking oil  Without potentially thousands of dollars worth of repair and investigative problem-solving    Which tells me that they do not know that particular motor very well and I felt uncomfortable with them doing investigative Motor Repair if they did not have a clear picture of what was going wrong to start with .  That first weekend, one of my guys who was supposed to bring the truck in did not end up making it in    So I called back the next week and let them know that we will be bringing it in this weekend .  I did not go into further explanation on what it was going to be serviced on this truck because that full detail was covered from the previous week    When we went to go pick the truck up on Monday morning   We were shocked to find the backdoor still in the state of disrepair that we left it   And that they had done the oil change that was specifically requested not to be done.  When I have confronted the shop about this issue   They said they were not going to charge me for the oil change, but they declined to do any further business.  Piss poor way to handle business in Dallas Fort Worth if you want to maintain a reputation.  My strong recommendation if you have an Isuzu diesel box truck   Is that you take it to industrial power  Or anywhere else because of my experience on how they treat you, you will end up spending way more money and not getting your problem solved

user_reviews.Name: Julie Nichols
user_reviews.Description:
I had trouble with my Honda Pilot that i had been working with the dealership on for several weeks.  By the time I was able to take my car in they determined the issue to be with a part that was 2 weeks out of warranty extension.  After going round and round with both the local service dept and Honda corporate and even showing all the text messages and pictures of the error message on my dash prior to the warranty expiration date, they still would not cover the repair and wanted to charge me many hundreds of dollars to fix the issue.

A friend recommend Malek at ESS and while it was a drive from where I am, I was so frustrated with the dealership service dept, I scheduled the time to meet with Malek.  After doing a full diagnostic they found the issue which was based on an old lingering code that had not been cleared from the electronics.

Taking my car to Malek (ESS) I learned that dealerships only want to sell parts to make money instead of actually fixing the issue for a much lower cost!  My car works great now with no errors popping up and all the car's original functionality performing the way it should.

I plan to bring my car back to Malek for all future maintenance and repairs!  He is the best and so much less expensive than the high priced dealerships!

user_reviews.Description: Well what can I say in this day and age. Yes the owner took me around the block and handed it to me really good charging me 2600 dollars to fix a 2 connectors and replace and install a throttle position sensor on my workhorse. Yes he charged me more than it cost me to rebuild my transmission. After 1800 miles it breaks down again with same symptoms , same codes , same problem whick he says the truck didnt have the first time even though i have it in writing from him showing the same problem again. He charged me for a diagnostic to read only the codes for me not a diagnostic testing the sensors and a seperate charge to connecdt the scanner to the plug. I dont know maybe he is really good for all i know but i could have bought and just plugged in my scanner for the price he charged me to plug his in since it doesnt tell me if the sensors are bad. To test the sensors you do what in the industry calls a bench test to see if the sensors are reponding with a pulse signal and for all 3 sensors to go bad at the same time is not likely to happen.. This owner is not honest about the way he is doing business and to gouge price people during a pandemic i dont think is right, maynbe not legal but am not sure on this, He has not attempted to make this right either so BUYER BE WARE he charges for everything to just look at it.

user_reviews.Name: Tanner Phillips
user_reviews.Description: They kept our vehicle for more than 3 months, with very little communication. Every time we did hear back about our step van, it was a different problem than before. I believe that their technician did not know what they were doing, and caused more harm than they fixed. A few months later and I am having trouble with my vehicle again, and since I do not trust this shop I dig into the problem myself only to find: my wiring harness resting on the exhaust manifold, ground bolts not tightened down, brackets laying off to the side, and wires strewn about outside of the protective conduit. If you want good honest work done by a "certified" shop, then do not bring it to Friendly Fleet.

user_reviews.Name: Capt Yogi Bear
user_reviews.Description:
When it comes to truck and trailer repair, finding a shop that is both reliable and genuinely committed to getting your rig back on the road can be a challenge. After my recent experience with A to Z Truck & Trailer Repair, I can confidently say they have set the gold standard for what exceptional service looks like in this industry.

From the moment I called, I knew I was in good hands. I was dealing with a serious issue: my trailer’s air lines and light wires were compromised, making it unsafe and illegal to continue my haul. The situation was complicated by the fact that Utility Trailer of Dallas, the usual source for specific parts, was closed for the day. This meant that sourcing certain components would be a challenge—something that could have easily turned a routine repair into a multi-day ordeal. But the team at A to Z rose to the challenge in a way that truly impressed me.

Communication and Customer Service:
From the outset, their communication was excellent. The staff listened carefully as I explained the issues I was facing. They didn’t rush me off the phone, nor did they make any unrealistic promises. Instead, they assured me that they would do everything possible to get me back on the road, even with the parts challenge. They kept in touch with regular updates, letting me know what progress was being made and what obstacles they were encountering.

Technical Expertise and Problem-Solving:
When I arrived at their shop, I could see right away that these mechanics were seasoned professionals. They diagnosed the problem swiftly and accurately, without any of the guesswork or unnecessary labor hours that some other shops might try to tack on. The technicians explained exactly what was wrong with my air lines and wiring, showing me the damaged sections and detailing the repairs they intended to make.

The most impressive part of the experience was the way they improvised without sacrificing quality. With Utility Trailer of Dallas closed and some parts unavailable, lesser shops might have simply turned me away or delayed the work. Not A to Z. They tapped into their inventory, creatively sourcing compatible parts and fabricating solutions as needed—all while ensuring everything met or exceeded DOT safety standards. Their resourcefulness was truly remarkable, and it’s clear they have extensive experience handling all kinds of trailer makes and models.

Quality of Work:
The repairs were meticulous. The team at A to Z didn’t just patch things together—they took the time to route the air lines and wires properly, securing everything to prevent future wear or malfunction. They double-checked every connection, tested the lighting circuits, and thoroughly inspected their work before calling it done. When I did my own walk-around inspection, I was honestly blown away by the attention to detail.

Efficiency and Professionalism:
Despite the late hour and the challenge of not having access to certain parts, the repairs were completed far faster than I expected. The staff stayed late to see the job through, never once making me feel like an inconvenience. When it came time to settle up, the invoice was fair and transparent, with no surprise charges or “mystery” fees. They took the time to explain the bill, answer my questions, and even provided some preventative maintenance tips to keep my rig in top shape moving forward.

Going the Extra Mile:
What really sets A to Z apart, in my opinion, is their commitment to the customer. They could have easily told me to come back when the parts store was open, but instead, they chose to go the extra mile. That kind of dedication is rare these days.

Summary:
If you’re looking for a repair shop that combines technical expertise, a can-do attitude, and genuine customer care, look no further than A to Z Truck & Trailer Repair. They turned what could have been a major setback into a smooth, hassle-free experience. My air lines and lights are now working flawlessly, and I feel confident knowing the repairs were done right.
